    SELECT user_id, windowFunnel(1209600)(toDateTime(timestamp), event = 'coupon_field_shown', event = 'coupon_applied') AS steps
    FROM promo_coupon_checkout_events
    WHERE event IN ('coupon_field_shown', 'coupon_applied')
    GROUP BY user_id
),
apply_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        countIf(steps >= 1) AS shown_users,
        countIf(steps = 2) AS applied_users,
        if(shown_users > 0, applied_users / shown_users, 0) AS rate
    FROM funnel_data

entered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM promo_coupon_checkout_events WHERE event = 'coupon_entered'
),

        count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo_coupon_checkout_events.event = 'coupon_applied' THEN promo_coupon_checkout_events.user_id END) AS valid_users,
        count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo_coupon_checkout_events.event = 'coupon_rejected' THEN promo_coupon_checkout_events.user_id END) AS rejected_users,
        (SELECT count() FROM entered) AS entered_users
    FROM promo_coupon_checkout_events

    WHERE promo_coupon_checkout_events.event IN ('coupon_applied', 'coupon_rejected')
),
